baselines.mean_effect: predict mean train beta; refit after source exclusion for OOD
baselines.nearest_neighbor: cosine nearest neighbor in standardized prefix-mean context; copy its beta; source-heldout pool excludes the heldout source
baselines.scientific_role: Baselines are diagnostics and comparative gates; neither can be selected as the learned router.

causal_scale.eta_rule: eta is solved from each target full Ghat exactly as in Core 009B-1; oracle/deploy/mean/NN effects all use this same eta

confirmation.peer_selection: deterministic SHA ordering; at most one peer per different source

forbidden: future hidden states beyond prefix boundary
context.normalization: feature mean/std fitted on router-training rows only; OOD source-heldout models refit normalization after excluding the heldout source
context.source_tensor: projected activation z = U^T h from the frozen inference path
context.summary_for_ridge_and_mlp: mean of prefix z tokens after train-only feature standardization
context.token_context_for_attention: prefix z tokens only; no token after the frozen prefix boundary is visible

data.selection_and_partition: exact Core 006/007/009A/009B-1/009B-2 pinned sequence selection; router examples may participate in projection preparation/extraction batching but never in 009B-3 train/eval router statistics

decision_question: Given a compact Core 009B-2 effect basis V, can inference-visible prefix context alone predict deployable effect coefficients beta_hat that recover most oracle causal target gain, remain correct under source-heldout routing, and avoid excess unrelated harm?

metrics: OOD residual improvement over mean baseline

effect_coordinates.basis: V_d = top-d uncentered covariance eigenspace fitted on all train effects using the locked Core 009B-2 dimension d
effect_coordinates.basis_fit_for_ood: V_d remains the all-train basis; source-heldout tests isolate router generalization rather than refitting the representation substrate
effect_coordinates.carrier: r = normalized mean projected activation fitted on all 009B-3 train rows for the seed, identical rule to 009B-2
effect_coordinates.oracle_effect: a_oracle = V_d beta_i = V_d V_d^T a_i

interpretation_boundary: A positive result supports deployable context-to-effect addressability for this frozen-Pythia regime only.
Discovery uses effect-space metrics only. Causal NLL results cannot select the router.
Confirmation uses actual causal lm-head NLL under the same inherited rho=0.01 scale as 009B-1.

Source-heldout evaluation excludes the heldout source from router fitting and context normalization but deliberately retains the all-train effect basis V to isolate addressability from representation geometry.
The learned router must beat the mean-effect baseline and must not be materially worse than nearest-neighbor retrieval.
No gradient, label, future token, oracle effect, or replay target may enter a router input.

parent_evidence.causal_rho_source: Core 009B-1 locked causal scale inherited through Core 009B-2 parent evidence

replication.formal_hardware: CPU-safe router discovery after frozen hidden/write extraction; GPU is required only for frozen foundation signature extraction and final causal NLL confirmation.

router_selection.rule: Choose the first family in the frozen hierarchy with a candidate that passes every discovery gate on both discovery seeds. Tiny attention is therefore forbidden when ridge or MLP already passes. Within a family choose the lowest parameter-count viable candidate, then lexical name.

scope.interpretation: 009B-3 tests deployable addressability only. It does not establish safe continual mutation or a confirmed CLM.

stop_rule.confirmation_failure: Stop before Core 010. Persistent effect memory is not deployably addressable under this hypothesis.
stop_rule.confirmation_iid_only: Stop before Core 010. Addressability does not generalize under the frozen source-heldout test.
stop_rule.confirmation_success: Proceed to Core 010 Certified Persistent Effect Memory. Do not claim a confirmed CLM architecture yet.
stop_rule.discovery_failure: Do not open confirmation. No deployable learned router met the frozen IID+OOD effect-space addressability gates.
stop_rule.parent_negative_or_missing: Do not run 009B-3 discovery. 009B-2 must first publish a scientific positive decision and basis lock.

title: Core Validation 009B-3 — Deployable Effect Addressability
